metadata.title: Unapproved MCP Data Exfiltration Investigation
metadata.description: Demonstrates how an indirect prompt injection can influence a finance agent to invoke an unapproved MCP tool and send confidential records to an external destination. This is synthetic training data for the local JSON import workflow.
metadata.statusReason: Synthetic evidence demonstrates the import and investigation experience. Replace every node with tenant-validated telemetry before operational use.

nodes.label: Finance analyst
nodes.description: A legitimate user asks the finance agent to summarize the quarterly reconciliation package.

nodes.label: Finance-Reconciliation-Agent
nodes.description: The agent instance that reads financial documents and invokes approved reconciliation tools.

nodes.label: Entra Agent ID: finance-prod
nodes.description: The service-principal identity used by the production finance agent.

nodes.label: Poisoned reconciliation document
nodes.description: A retrieved document contains hidden instructions directing the agent to use an external MCP export tool.
evidence: Prompt Shield marker: indirect attack suspected

nodes.label: Summarize Q3 reconciliation
nodes.description: The user's benign request causes the agent to retrieve and process the poisoned document.

nodes.label: Model selects export workflow
nodes.description: The model follows the injected instruction and chooses an export tool that is not in the approved inventory.
evidence: No native model-reasoning record is asserted

nodes.label: Unapproved MCP server
nodes.description: An externally hosted MCP server exposes a general-purpose export_records tool.
evidence: Target absent from the approved MCP allowlist

nodes.label: ExecuteTool: export_records
nodes.description: The finance agent invokes the unapproved tool with identifiers for confidential reconciliation records.

nodes.label: Confidential finance library
nodes.description: The SharePoint resource containing quarterly reconciliations and vendor-payment evidence.

nodes.label: External collection endpoint
nodes.description: The destination controlled by the unapproved MCP integration.
evidence: Synthetic domain uses the reserved .invalid suffix
No real network destination is contacted

nodes.label: AppDependencies tool span
nodes.description: OpenTelemetry records the agent, conversation, tool, target, result, and shared operation ID.

nodes.label: Unified agent execution event
nodes.description: Agent 365 observability records the source agent, tool invocation, actor, and external target.

nodes.label: Unapproved MCP tool detection
nodes.description: A detection correlates the first-seen external MCP target, sensitive resource context, and export tool invocation.

nodes.label: Potential agent-driven data exfiltration
nodes.description: The observed chain is consistent with an agent being manipulated into sending confidential records to an unapproved external integration.
evidence: Successful receipt by a real attacker is not demonstrated

nodes.label: Disable integration and contain identity
nodes.description: The response plan disables the MCP integration, blocks the target, reviews the Agent ID grants, and opens a Sentinel incident.
evidence: Recommended action only; no automatic change is performed
